value.rationale: Natural modal quotients of Boolean inclusion Kripke frames are stricter than arbitrary monotone maps. This work classifies the exact back-lifting frontier, supplies a general exact invariant, establishes the existence threshold n=2, and gives a motivated previously-uncovered exact 32-world census sharply distinct from the order-polynomial count. The enumeration is labelled and the scope explicit; absence of a simple product formula is a limitation, not an unsupported significance claim.
